info.title: Simula Native Ad Server
info.description: Campaign/ad-set management, session resolution and native ad serving with geo + OS targeting, bandit ranking and LLM ad copy.

get.description: Liveness -- is the process up. No dependencies touched.

Readiness -- can we actually serve. Checks Mongo and Redis.

Split from liveness on purpose: a Redis blip should stop traffic being
routed here, but must not get the container killed and restarted.

post.description:
Resolve the caller to a stable user and return their session id.

Resolve-or-create: within the inactivity window the same caller gets the
same `session_id` back, which is what makes the 30s rule observable.

get.description: Inspect a session. Useful for debugging and for the demo script.

post.description: Serve a native sponsored-character ad for a feed slot.

Click callback fired by the rendered creative.

The template calls this endpoint directly, so it exists even though the
brief does not list it. Returns 202 on an unknown or already-counted id
rather than 404: click pixels are fire-and-forget and retried by the
browser, and a duplicate must never look like a failure the client should
retry harder.
